meta.name: antinet-four-color-cards
meta.description: 财务和投资分析师、律师助理与法律助手在撰写金融研报或分析法律文档时，必用此技能！基于解析文档一键生成事实蓝卡、解释绿卡、风险黄卡与行动红卡。自动完成深度剖析与风险排查，产出100%可溯源的结构化四色报告，让复杂分析高效且严谨。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 解析文档,生成四色分析卡,让复杂金融与法律分析高效严谨
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要快速梳理金融研报或法律文档中的事实与风险
copy.tagline_en: Turn complex documents into structured four-color analysis reports for finance and law.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to break down financial reports or legal documents into key facts and risks.

howto.what: Claude 会把已解析的文档转成四色卡片：蓝卡写事实、绿卡写解释、黄卡标风险、红卡给行动建议，每张卡附来源片段以便溯源。
howto.when: 当你提供解析好的结构化文档、要写金融研报或分析法律文档时触发；也可按 extract、review、propose 三个阶段分别运行。

say.text: 请把这份文档生成四色卡片报告。
say.note: 产出蓝绿黄红四张卡，各带来源。

say.text: 先跑 extract 阶段，抽取事实生成蓝卡。
黄卡的风险点请标记，等待监察院复核。
say.note: 复核未完成时黄卡标 pending_review。

howto.what_en: Claude turns a parsed document into four color cards: blue for facts, green for explanation, yellow for risks, red for next-step actions. Each card keeps its source snippet so it can be traced.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you supply a parsed structured document for financial research or legal document analysis, or when you run the extract, review, or propose stage separately.

say_en.text: Generate a four-color card report from this document.
say_en.note: Outputs blue, green, yellow and red cards with sources.

say_en.text: Run the extract stage to pull facts into blue cards.
say_en.note: Runs only the blue-card fact extraction.

say_en.text: Flag the risks in the yellow card for review.
say_en.note: Yellow card is marked pending_review until reviewed.
